subject: Trouble loading AHMbook in R and running its functions

messages.author: e5841ce9d01eda50
messages.subject: Trouble loading AHMbook in R and running its functions
parts:
Hello all,
I'm just starting out with hierarchical modelling and figured the best way to go through the text and start working through the scripts.
However, I keep getting this error message when I try to load the AHMbook package and then it can't find any of it's functions, including the first in the book!

> library("AHMbook")
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘AHMbook’ in loadNamespace(j <- i[[1L]], c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[j]]):
 there is no package called ‘plotrix’
In addition: Warning message:
package ‘AHMbook’ was built under R version 3.4.4 
> sim.fn(quad.size = 10, cell.size = 1, intensity = 1)
Error in sim.fn(quad.size = 10, cell.size = 1, intensity = 1) : 
  could not find function "sim.fn"


I've tried separately loading al these as well, or finding different paths, but no luck...
install.packages(c("unmarked", "plotrix", "sp", "raster", "RandomFields", "coda"))
install.packages("AHMbook", repos = "http://mikemeredith.net/R")

Do I need to go back to a previous version of R to run the package?
Please help.

-Adrienne

messages.author: 72444bb824190d51
messages.subject: Re: Trouble loading AHMbook in R and running its functions
parts:
Dear Adrienne,

Sorry you have trouble with the AHMbook package. Not sure what's wrong but the clue is
package ‘AHMbook’ was built under R version 3.4.4

Unless you are still using R 3.4.x, that suggests you've got an old compiled AHMbook package from somewhere, possibly a mirror site that has not been updated.

If you are using R 3.5 or R3.6 you should be able to do install.packages("AHMbook") to install AHMbook 0.1.4 from CRAN.

Because of changes to R and contributed packages, some of the original code put together in 2015 no longer works. You will find code which should work with current versions here.

There is a development version of AHMbook which includes stuff for volume 2, which will go to CRAN when vol 2 is published. That's on Github here; if you want to try it out, use
devtools::install_github("mikemeredith/AHMbook")

If you are still having problems, please do
sessionInfo()
 and paste the output into your post.

Regards, Mike
